title: 電透析除鹽系統~Electrodialysis desalination systems
focus: 離子遷移、極化與淡濃水收支~Ion transport, polarization and dilute/concentrate balances
summary: 以「離子遷移、極化與淡濃水收支」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。~Follow ion transport, polarization and dilute/concentrate balances through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.

units.title: 定義除鹽負荷~Define the desalination load
units.mechanism: 先把流量和鹽濃度轉成相同時間基準的質量流率；導電度只是在離子組成固定時的替代量。~Convert flow and salt concentration into a mass rate on one time basis; conductivity is a surrogate only for a stable ionic composition.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Q=20 m3/h; C=1.5 kg/m3; m=QC；計算 20*1.5 = 30 kg/h。適用限制：穩態且忽略密度改變。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Q=20 m3/h; C=1.5 kg/m3; m=QC; calculation 20*1.5 = 30 kg/h. Applicability: Steady state with negligible density change.
units.verify: 改變流量而固定鹽濃度，核對質量流率斜率。~Vary flow at fixed salinity and check the mass-rate slope.
units.failure: 只比較導電度會掩蓋流量增加造成的鹽負荷上升。~Conductivity alone hides a salt-load increase caused by higher flow.
units.misconception: 濃度相同就代表每小時除鹽負荷相同。~Equal concentration means equal hourly salt load.
units.practice: 在「定義除鹽負荷」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 30 kg/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只比較導電度會掩蓋流量增加造成的鹽負荷上升。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for define the desalination load, first reproduce 30 kg/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Conductivity alone hides a salt-load increase caused by higher flow." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 電荷與離子當量~Charge and ionic equivalents
units.mechanism: 膜選擇性和電流效率把電荷流轉成有效離子輸送；以當量而非總離子莫耳直接計數。~Membrane selectivity and current efficiency convert charge into useful ionic transport; count charge equivalents rather than unweighted ion moles.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：n_eq=eta I t/F; eta=0.9; I=10 A; t=3600 s; F=96485 C/mol；計算 0.9*10*3600/96485 = 0.335803 mol-equivalent。適用限制：單一膜對等效量，不乘未定義的膜數。~Original hypothetical teaching example: n_eq=eta I t/F; eta=0.9; I=10 A; t=3600 s; F=96485 C/mol; calculation 0.9*10*3600/96485 = 0.335803 mol-equivalent. Applicability: Equivalent transfer for one cell pair; no undefined cell-count multiplier.
units.verify: 改變電流並量測淡濃水離子收支，以反算效率。~Vary current and use dilute/concentrate ionic balances to infer efficiency.
units.failure: 把二價離子當成一價會低估所需電荷。~Treating divalent ions as monovalent underestimates charge demand.
units.misconception: 一莫耳所有離子都只需一法拉第。~Every mole of ions requires exactly one Faraday.
units.practice: 在「電荷與離子當量」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.335803 mol-equivalent，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把二價離子當成一價會低估所需電荷。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for charge and ionic equivalents, first reproduce 0.335803 mol-equivalent, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating divalent ions as monovalent underestimates charge demand." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 膜面積與電流密度~Membrane area and current density
units.mechanism: 總電流需除以有效膜面積；邊框、遮蔽與流道分布會讓局部電流密度高於平均。~Divide current by active membrane area; frames, masking and flow maldistribution can make local density exceed its average.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：j=I/A; I=12 A; A=0.30 m2；計算 12/0.30 = 40 A/m2。適用限制：平均值不代替局部極限電流試驗。~Original hypothetical teaching example: j=I/A; I=12 A; A=0.30 m2; calculation 12/0.30 = 40 A/m2. Applicability: An average does not replace a local limiting-current test.
units.verify: 把有效面積減少10%，繪出平均電流密度變化。~Reduce active area by ten percent and plot mean current density.
units.failure: 用膜外框面積會把電流密度估得過低。~Using the frame area understates current density.
units.misconception: 電流相同時膜面積不影響電流密度。~At equal current membrane area does not affect current density.
units.practice: 在「膜面積與電流密度」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 40 A/m2，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「用膜外框面積會把電流密度估得過低。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for membrane area and current density, first reproduce 40 A/m2, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using the frame area understates current density." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 濃差極化餘裕~Concentration-polarization margin
units.mechanism: 邊界層離子補給限制膜面電流；接近極限時升高電壓可能主要增加水分解和局部化學變化。~Boundary-layer ion supply limits membrane current; near the limit extra voltage can mainly increase water splitting and local chemistry changes.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：margin=(jlim-j)/jlim; jlim=60; j=40 A/m2；計算 (60-40)/60 = 0.333333 fraction。適用限制：jlim 是假想量測結果，不是通用操作上限。~Original hypothetical teaching example: margin=(jlim-j)/jlim; jlim=60; j=40 A/m2; calculation (60-40)/60 = 0.333333 fraction. Applicability: The limiting current is a hypothetical measurement, not a universal operating limit.
units.verify: 比較兩種流速的電流—電壓曲線，找出平台轉折。~Compare current-voltage curves at two flow velocities and locate the plateau transition.
units.failure: 以清水的極限值套用高污染進水，可能忽略結垢與流道阻塞。~Applying a clean-water limit to fouling feed ignores scaling and channel obstruction.
units.misconception: 提高電壓必定同比提高有效除鹽量。~Raising voltage always proportionally raises useful desalination.
units.practice: 在「濃差極化餘裕」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.333333 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「以清水的極限值套用高污染進水，可能忽略結垢與流道阻塞。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for concentration-polarization margin, first reproduce 0.333333 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Applying a clean-water limit to fouling feed ignores scaling and channel obstruction." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 堆疊電阻與電耗~Stack resistance and energy
units.mechanism: 膜、溶液與接觸構成等效電阻；電耗必須以產水量歸一化並納入電源效率。~Membrane, solution and contacts contribute resistance; normalize electrical use by product volume and include power-supply efficiency.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：SEC=VI/(eta Q); V=100 V; I=10 A; eta=0.9; Q=5 m3/h; divide W by1000；計算 100*10/(0.9*5*1000) = 0.222222 kWh/m3。適用限制：膜堆供電端輸入電耗，含電源損失但未含泵浦。~Original hypothetical teaching example: SEC=VI/(eta Q); V=100 V; I=10 A; eta=0.9; Q=5 m3/h; divide W by1000; calculation 100*10/(0.9*5*1000) = 0.222222 kWh/m3. Applicability: Stack power-supply input electricity, including supply losses but excluding pumps.
units.verify: 保持產水量，增加電阻並比較電壓和比電耗。~Hold production fixed, increase resistance, and compare voltage and specific energy.
units.failure: 把瓦特直接當千瓦時每立方公尺會錯用時間與流量單位。~Treating watts as kWh per cubic metre mixes time and flow units.
units.misconception: 瞬時功率就是每立方公尺耗能。~Instantaneous power equals energy per cubic metre.
units.practice: 在「堆疊電阻與電耗」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.222222 kWh/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把瓦特直接當千瓦時每立方公尺會錯用時間與流量單位。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for stack resistance and energy, first reproduce 0.222222 kWh/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Treating watts as kWh per cubic metre mixes time and flow units." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 水回收率與濃水~Water recovery and concentrate
units.mechanism: 回收率提高會把殘餘鹽分集中到較少濃水；產水品質和濃水處置必須同時檢核。~Higher recovery concentrates residual salt into less brine; check product quality and concentrate handling together.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Qc=Qf-Qp; Qf=10; Qp=7.5 m3/h；計算 10-7.5 = 2.5 m3/h。適用限制：不考慮滲透水遷移與採樣損失的體積收支。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Qc=Qf-Qp; Qf=10; Qp=7.5 m3/h; calculation 10-7.5 = 2.5 m3/h. Applicability: Volume balance neglecting osmotic transfer and sample losses.
units.verify: 把產水量由7.5改成8，重算濃水與鹽濃度。~Raise product flow from7.5 to8 and recalculate concentrate flow and salinity.
units.failure: 只報回收率可能隱藏濃水量減少後的結垢風險。~Recovery alone hides scaling risk as concentrate volume falls.
units.misconception: 提高回收率不會改變濃水條件。~Higher recovery leaves concentrate conditions unchanged.
units.practice: 在「水回收率與濃水」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 2.5 m3/h，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只報回收率可能隱藏濃水量減少後的結垢風險。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for water recovery and concentrate, first reproduce 2.5 m3/h, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Recovery alone hides scaling risk as concentrate volume falls." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 淡濃水鹽平衡~Dilute-concentrate salt balance
units.mechanism: 用進料鹽流扣除產水鹽流求濃水濃度；此收支可抓出流量計或分析偏差。~Subtract product salt flow from feed salt flow to find brine concentration; this balance exposes flow-meter or analytical bias.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：Cc=(Qf Cf-Qp Cp)/Qc; Qf=10,Cf=1,Qp=7.5,Cp=0.2,Qc=2.5；計算 (10*1-7.5*0.2)/2.5 = 3.4 kg/m3。適用限制：穩態且鹽未沉澱。~Original hypothetical teaching example: Cc=(Qf Cf-Qp Cp)/Qc; Qf=10,Cf=1,Qp=7.5,Cp=0.2,Qc=2.5; calculation (10*1-7.5*0.2)/2.5 = 3.4 kg/m3. Applicability: Steady state without salt precipitation.
units.verify: 同時抽取三股流並保留取樣時刻。~Sample all three streams synchronously and retain timestamps.
units.failure: 非同步樣品在進水變動時會造成假的失衡。~Asynchronous samples create a false imbalance during feed changes.
units.misconception: 只測淡水即可完成全堆鹽平衡。~Measuring diluate alone closes the stack salt balance.
units.practice: 在「淡濃水鹽平衡」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3.4 kg/m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「非同步樣品在進水變動時會造成假的失衡。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for dilute-concentrate salt balance, first reproduce 3.4 kg/m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Asynchronous samples create a false imbalance during feed changes." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 結垢趨勢與反轉~Scaling trends and reversal
units.mechanism: 極性反轉可調整膜面的離子累積，但不能取代硬度、鹼度與飽和度評估。~Polarity reversal changes ion accumulation at membrane surfaces but does not replace hardness, alkalinity or saturation assessment.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：concentration factor=Cc/Cf=3.4/1；計算 3.4/1 = 3.4 ratio。適用限制：濃縮倍率不是沉澱飽和指數。~Original hypothetical teaching example: concentration factor=Cc/Cf=3.4/1; calculation 3.4/1 = 3.4 ratio. Applicability: Concentration factor is not a precipitation saturation index.
units.verify: 比較反轉前後壓差和電阻，區分流道阻塞與膜污染。~Compare pressure drop and resistance before/after reversal to distinguish channel blockage from membrane fouling.
units.failure: 把濃縮倍率直接當溶解度安全係數會漏掉離子活度效應。~Using concentration factor as a solubility safety factor misses activity effects.
units.misconception: 只要使用反轉就不需要前處理。~Reversal eliminates the need for pretreatment.
units.practice: 在「結垢趨勢與反轉」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 3.4 ratio，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「把濃縮倍率直接當溶解度安全係數會漏掉離子活度效應。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for scaling trends and reversal, first reproduce 3.4 ratio, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Using concentration factor as a solubility safety factor misses activity effects." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 流道泵浦功率~Channel pumping power
units.mechanism: 增加流速可降低邊界層厚度，卻提高泵功；需比較總能耗而非只看堆電耗。~Higher velocity can thin the boundary layer while increasing pumping demand; compare total rather than stack-only energy.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：P=DeltaP Q/eta; DeltaP=50000 Pa; Q=0.002 m3/s; eta=0.65；計算 50000*0.002/0.65 = 153.846 W。適用限制：不可壓水流的泵輸入功率；eta為整體電至水效率。~Original hypothetical teaching example: P=DeltaP Q/eta; DeltaP=50000 Pa; Q=0.002 m3/s; eta=0.65; calculation 50000*0.002/0.65 = 153.846 W. Applicability: Pump input power for incompressible water; eta is overall wire-to-water efficiency.
units.verify: 把流量加倍，另行量測壓差而非假設不變。~Double flow and measure pressure drop rather than assuming it stays fixed.
units.failure: 泵效率和堆效率混為一談會低估總耗電。~Confusing pump and stack efficiencies understates total electricity.
units.misconception: 流速增加的能源成本永遠可忽略。~The energy cost of higher velocity is always negligible.
units.practice: 在「流道泵浦功率」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 153.846 W，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「泵效率和堆效率混為一談會低估總耗電。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for channel pumping power, first reproduce 153.846 W, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Confusing pump and stack efficiencies understates total electricity." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

units.title: 產品異常的聯鎖證據~Evidence for product-quality interlocks
units.mechanism: 電導度突升、流量異常與電阻變化需要共同判讀；教學聯鎖應把不確定產水導向隔離狀態。~Interpret conductivity spikes, flow anomalies and resistance changes together; teaching interlocks divert uncertain product to an isolated state.
units.model: 原創假想教學算例：delay volume=Q t; Q=5 m3/h; t=30 s；計算 5*30/3600 = 0.0416667 m3。適用限制：只計偵測延遲的流過體積，未含管線存水。~Original hypothetical teaching example: delay volume=Q t; Q=5 m3/h; t=30 s; calculation 5*30/3600 = 0.0416667 m3. Applicability: Through-volume during detection delay only, excluding pipe inventory.
units.verify: 注入假想感測延遲並追蹤受影響水量。~Inject a hypothetical sensor delay and track the affected volume.
units.failure: 忽略延遲會把警報之前的產水當作已驗證。~Ignoring delay treats pre-alarm product as verified.
units.misconception: 警報發出後就代表之前所有產水均合格。~An alarm means all earlier product was acceptable.
units.practice: 在「產品異常的聯鎖證據」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.0416667 m3，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「忽略延遲會把警報之前的產水當作已驗證。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。~In the teaching model or spreadsheet for evidence for product-quality interlocks, first reproduce 0.0416667 m3, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Ignoring delay treats pre-alarm product as verified." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.

history: 本課以來源所列的技術指引與研究為閱讀脈絡，並非重建某一設施的工程沿革；算例、數據與場景參數皆為原創教學假設。比較舊方法與感測、控制、資源回收整合的方法時，先固定處理功能及系統邊界，再評估效率與可靠度。~The cited technical guidance and research provide a reading pathway, not the engineering history of a particular facility. Examples, data and scene parameters are original teaching assumptions. When comparing conventional methods with integrated sensing, control and resource recovery, hold the treatment function and system boundary fixed before assessing efficiency and reliability.
